Country of origin: VN

Chosen so far: 08 Fruit and nuts, edible; peel of citrus fruit or melons > 0801 Nuts, edible; coconuts, Brazil nuts and cashew nuts, fresh or dried, whether or not shelled or peeled

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 080132: Nuts, edible; cashew nuts, fresh or dried, shelled
